equal_weight_weights = {ticker: 1/len(tickers) for ticker in tickers}

total_inverse_volatility = sum(inverse_volatility_weights.values())

def portfolio_variance(weights, cov_matrix):
    return np.dot(weights.T, np.dot(cov_matrix, weights))

min_variance_weights = {ticker: weight for ticker, weight in zip(tickers, result.x)}
